name: OpenAI Python SDK
one_liner: Official Python client for the OpenAI REST API.
what_it_is: A library providing convenient access to the OpenAI REST API from Python, in its own words. Requests and responses are typed, and the request shape it defines is also implemented by several other providers and gateways.
why_it_matters: Calling the API directly is the smallest thing that works, and for a single provider it is usually the clearest code to read a year later. The catch is that the surface is one vendor: model names, parameters and newer capabilities are theirs, and portability is something you add on top rather than get from it.
suitable_for: Cases where the clearest possible request path matters
Using capabilities before an abstraction layer supports them
not_suitable_for: Applications that must move between providers without a rewrite
Central cost control across several teams
Local or self-hosted models, which it does not target
